dedupe_keys.name: danube fis portal fairway information for the danube and its navigable tributaries

description: The Danube FIS Portal is the joint fairway information service of the Danube waterway administrations of Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Romania and Bulgaria, among them via donau, the Slovak Water Management Enterprise, Hungary's General Directorate of Water Management, Serbia's Plovput and the River Administration of the Lower Danube. It gives river kilometre-based information for the Danube and navigable tributaries and canals such as the Drava, Sava, Tisza, Prut and the Danube-Black Sea Canal: critical fairway bottlenecks with width, minimum actual depth and sounding dates, locks with their chambers, bridges, berths, ports, authorities, water levels, ice reports and notices to skippers, together with electronic and paper navigational charts and Inland ENC layers on a map. Coverage is continental, the Danube corridor in seven countries. The information is free to view on the web portal in the riparian languages and English; it was set up in the EU-funded NEWADA and NEWADA duo projects and improved by Danube STREAM until 2019. Caveats: a disclaimer stresses the informative character of the published data, and bulk download is not offered on the pages read. The bottleneck depths, lock data and water levels support inland waterway capacity, low-water disruption and route analyses. The portal complements the EURIS inland waterway network graphs and is related to the CCNR market observation.
